snippet.title: Introduction to Aizu Online Judge and AOJ-ICPC
snippet.description:
AOJ is a bland online judge, made by University of Aizu, but solver helping tool is so useful. Solving AOJ-ICPC problems will help your implementation skills, so (future) ICPC contestants should try once!

Aizu Online Judge: http://judge.u-aizu.ac.jp/onlinejudge/
AOJ-ICPC: http://aoj-icpc.ichyo.jp/

snippet.title: Introduction to new contest system: AtCoder
snippet.description:
Do you know AtCoder? It's Japanese originated programming contest website! Recently, they started to focus on international participants, and provide problem statements in English!
I created the video for those who don't know about AtCoder well, and also introduce several useful tools also for AtCoders!!

The contest problems are managed by rng_58, former TopCoder admin, so I'm sure that they have high quality problems!!

If you like this video, compete in AtCoder contests as well as click the subscribe button.
